Terraform at Scale: Modules, Workspaces vs Folders, Drift and Safe Apply

After this page you can package infrastructure as versioned modules, keep dev, staging and prod apart with the right state layout, catch manual console changes before they bite, and run plan and apply in CI so one bad change cannot take down a whole company.
